normalization_plan.reason: The _id parameter only exists to select the buy-now listing handled by buyEditionToken and should collapse into that function node
The _listingPrice parameter is consumed solely by listForBuyNow when building the Listing struct
The _offerPrice parameter is only used as a guard inside acceptEditionBid
The _recipient parameter only influences the transfer target inside buyEditionTokenFor
The _bidder parameter only determines who is credited in placeEditionBidFor
The listing storage pointer is a pure accessor inside _facilitateBuyNow
The reserveAuction storage pointer is a pure accessor inside resultReserveAuction
The offer struct is a transient read inside acceptEditionBid
winningBid is a transient cache used only by resultReserveAuction
koCommission is a derived arithmetic value that exists only inside handleSecondarySaleFunds
lockupUntil is a derived timestamp stored only by _placeEditionBidFor
